article.title: Arrest to be made strictly according to Sanhita
article.content:
62Arrest to be made strictly according to Sanhita



Section 62 · Chapter V


No arrest shall be made except in accordance with the provisions of this Sanhita or any other law for
                the time being in force providing for arrest.
